notes.title: Becloudead - Dev Blog
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

I started a Dev Blog for Becloudead earlier this month.

The blog currently includes 10 posts, summarizing and highlighting our development process for the past two year.

I will be posting our updates to it throughout the development process and you are welcome to join the ride!

It's a pretty fast read and to the point, check it out!
[url=http://headbangames.com/becloudead/devblog]Becloudead - Dev Blog[/url]

notes.title: Becloudead v0.58.0 released!
notes.notes:
We just released version 0.58.0, here are some of the new stuff:

[olist]
[*]Improved fighting system.
[*]New weapon - Sledge hammer.
[*]Crowbar weapon - extended range.
[*]Knife weapon - additional underwater upward attack angle.
[*]New air and charged attacks for all weapons.
[*]Updated controls and mechanics.
[*]New and updated player animations.
[*]Updated in-game UI and menus.
[*]A bunch of bug fixed.
[/olist]

Aside for that, we've been running a closed beta for the Prologue act, which will be the official demo of the game.
If you're interested in testing the beta, contact us on [url=https://twitter.com/HeadBangGames]twitter[/url].

notes.title: Halloween Special
notes.notes:
Halloween time is once again upon us, no better time to play Becloudead - Halloween special!
Our Xmas and Easter special are no less spooky and creepy, check them out as well!

We've been updating the specials periodically with gameplay updates, UI, visuals and more and we'll keep updating with every new addition.

Last but not least, we're going to start a closed beta testing for the official demo (Prologue act) on Halloween Eve!
If you're interested in joining the beta test you can contact us here, on our social channels or through this email: avishaymizrav@gmail.com

notes.title: Halloween Special - Updated
notes.notes:
It's been 3 weeks since we released our first playable alpha demo in the form of a Halloween Special.
During this time we kept working on the game, improving, polishing, addressing feedback and fixing bugs.

Today we uploaded a new version and we also updated the trailer video showcasing the changes, here is a list of some of the things we've done:

[olist]
[*]New tiles design.
[*]Updated backgrounds (moon, clouds, fog, lampposts and more).
[*]New snakes and jellyfish enemies.
[*]New spiders design.
[*]Updated player's controls.
[*]Updated blood particles and animations, it's even bloodier this time.
[*]Improved underwater attacks.
[*]Updated level design.
[*]Bugs fixes and more...
[/olist]

We are still working on the official demo for the game, but that might take a while, in the meantime we are cooking another special release for Xmas, stay tuned for more updates, coming soon!

notes.title: Down Below - Halloween Special
notes.notes:
Next week we're releasing a free to play Halloween Special demo for Down Below.

The demo is relatively short (about 15 minutes) and it showcase some of the game's mechanics and combat systems.

The demo is built using the latest alpha build of the game. If you encounter any bugs or have any feedback regarding gameplay/mechanics, please let us know on the game's Steam community page.

Note: This demo was made specially for Halloween and does not represent the final product.

Enjoy playing and have a spooky Halloween!
